title: First short a
note: Short a with consonants; x and vowel teams come later.

title: Short e and i
note: Introduce short e and short i.

title: Short o and u
note: Introduce short o and short u; x represents two sounds.

title: Consonant teams
note: Introduce sh, ch, th, ck and doubled consonants.

title: Blends and vowel teams
note: Blend adjacent consonants, then introduce ai, ee, oa, oo and split digraphs.
